title: ittcsecscan classify list --json output
description: The business-criticality override audit history for a tenant, oldest first. Each entry is one appended, audited human decision; the latest entry for an entity is the effective override.

tenant.description: The tenant the overrides belong to.

entity.description: The target entity's tenant-scoped stable id (64 lowercase hex).

resource.description: The entity's native id, resolved for readability. Absent when the entity is no longer present.

criticality.description: The business-criticality level set by this override.

reason.description: Why the override was set. Absent when none was given.

at.description: When the override was set (RFC 3339, UTC).
